Author Talk: Local Histories

Sunday 4 October 2026, 6:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

A conversation with two writers whose recent books cover the suburb's timber mills and its river floods. Books for sale and signing. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm.

Free. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
